name: Vine Whip
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Your Ward Plant grows a long tendril that you may use as a melee weapon. It has a reach of 5ft, has finesse, grants one d4 engagement die, and deals 1d4+BODY damage on a hit.

Describe your whip.

improvements.name: Vine Rope
improvements.description: Once per rest: While Vine Whip is in effect, you may spend a half action to extend the tendril into a long vine that extends out to short range. It can grip and release objects at your command and can hold up to 300 lbs of weight.
